display.name: Slack
display.blurb: Post messages, read channels, and upload files — authenticated with a workspace bot token obtained via OAuth ("Add to Slack").

cli.doc:
Use `slack` to interact with Slack from this session — post messages, list channels/users, upload files. Authentication is automatic: the egress proxy injects the workspace bot token on requests to slack.com; `SLACK_TOKEN` is a managed placeholder. Do NOT set a real token or run any login.

Post a message: `slack post <channel> <text>` — channel is an ID like C0123456789 or #name; the bot must be in the channel (or the app needs the chat:write.public scope). Requires the `chat:write` power.
List channels: `slack channels` (requires `channels:read`). List users: `slack users` (requires `users:read`).
Upload a file: `slack upload <channel> <path> [title]` (requires `files:write`).
Identity check: `slack whoami`. Any other Web API method: `slack api <method> field=value …` (e.g. `slack api chat.postMessage channel=C0123456789 text=hi`). Slack replies with JSON {"ok":true,…} or {"ok":false,"error":…}.
